## Fixed

- **Open folder opens the right folder.** On Windows it opened Documents whenever the file's path had a space in it; Explorer now opens the file's folder with the file selected, whatever its name (spaces, commas, any language). macOS (Finder) and Linux (the file manager) do the same.
- **The download bar no longer jumps back and forth on YouTube.** It counts the video and the audio against one total, known from the start, and only moves forward; joining them comes after, as its own processing step.

## Faster video downloads

- **YouTube and other video sites now download with NDM's own engine.** yt-dlp only finds the video; NDM then fetches the video and the audio at the same time, each split into segments over several connections, like any other download, with the Speed Limiter and the networks you chose. Streams yt-dlp must fetch itself (some live and segmented streams) still go through yt-dlp.
